setup.description: CLK0 (6m, the wanted signal is the fundamental) with the Si5351 screened and a screened pad at the output, then the 9-pole Chebyshev low-pass, 30 cm of cable and the BNC attenuator marked 10 dB

chain.name: screened pad on the CLK0 output
chain.notes: fully screened pad, nominal 8 dB; measured 8.7 dB at 50 MHz (8.5 to 9.5 dB over 20 to 180 MHz) on 2026-11-03. Placed BEFORE the filter, so it is not part of pad_db: levels in the results are those leaving the filter, with this pad's loss included in them.

chain.name: 9-pole Chebyshev low-pass
chain.notes: cutoff 64 MHz; home built; fitted directly after the pad (no pigtail). In the 2026-11-03 sweep on a 12 cm pigtail it lost 1.9 dB at 51 MHz (0.4 to 2.5 dB ripple in the passband), -3 dB near 67 MHz, 15-17 dB at 70-70.5 MHz

chain.name: 30 cm cable
chain.notes: filter to the attenuator; the same cable as in the pad measurements; type not recorded

chain.name: attenuator
chain.notes: in front of the analyser; marked 10 dB, about 27 dB at VHF (flat 20-180 MHz, measured earlier); not re-measured at 50 MHz in this chain

setup.notes: New topology (2026-11-03): screened board, screened pad at the output, filter straight after the pad. Compare with 6m-screened-pad-nofilter-10dB (the same chain without the filter) and 6m-chebyshev-lpf-64MHz-38dB (the old unscreened baseline). pad_db is 27.0 (cable and attenuator after the filter), so levels are 'leaving the filter' with the 8.7 dB source pad included.

note: new screened topology, screened pad at CLK0, then the 9-pole Chebyshev directly after the pad; forced: 8 mA reads -24.3 dBm at the analyser, 0.7 dB over the -25 dBm limit
